statements.statement: The patient presents with persistent palpitations and symptomatic bradycardia consistent with a history of sick sinus syndrome.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management.
The diagnoses addressed are I49.5 and R00.2.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197 for lack of required precertification or prior authorization.
